meta.title: The Forest
meta.subtitle: The whispering woodland behind Hattie’s house — every path, pond, and burrow from the stories, above ground and below.
meta.note: No potion needed — the forest is crossed on foot, with lanterns and flashlights, holding hands on the way home.

locations.name: Christmas Tree Mountain
locations.curatedDescription: A mountain stacked like a great evergreen, rising at the forest's far corner. Partway up, a single shiny bunny ornament glints among the boughs — and anyone who knows to look for it will find the secret tunnel entrance to the gopher world hidden just behind.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: Well, if you come across a field and into the forest and then partway up the Christmas Tree Mountain and then you just look for the bunny ornament, then you can find the tunnel entrance

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: She takes, go to the woods, past the bunny ornament, past Christmas Tree Mountain, then climb a staircase, then go over a rooftop, then I'm there.

stories.title: Kitty's Crew and the Underground Adventure

locations.name: The Muddy Mountain
locations.curatedDescription: A big mysterious mountain with a big hole and a little hole on its face, squishy mud in its dark passages, and — if you walk all the way around the back — a little round wooden door with a handle. Inside: hidden tunnels, an underground stream, tiny mushrooms, and a strange green glow.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: But there's a big hole on the front, and there's a little hole on the front of the mountain.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And so she walked around to the back of the mountain and she saw the door. It was a little round door and it was made of wood and it had a little handle.

stories.title: Hattie and the Mystery of the Muddy Mountain

locations.name: The Canyon
locations.curatedDescription: A narrow place between two steep cliffs of rock, where a little stream runs trickle-trickle-trickle over the stones. Little trees and bushes cling to the walls, and birds sail in and out between the cliffs.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: And then they went to the canyon!

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: The canyon is a place between two steep cliffs of rock. And inside the canyon, there was a little stream running. And it made a trickling sound... trickle-trickle-trickle-trickle.

stories.title: Hattie's Shell Necklace Adventure

locations.name: Peacock the Wizard's Castle
locations.curatedDescription: Crowned upon a great hill where the forest paths finally climb into the open, the gray stone castle of Peacock the Wizard waits with its gate (an elephant opens it). A spiral staircase goes clunk-clunk-clunk up the tower to Peacock's cozy nest, and a string on the wall rings a tiny bell at the very top. Every quest through the woods seems to begin or end here.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: She go'd to the Wizard castle.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: Now, over here is the fireplace where we can get warm when it's cold and there's a little table with lots of games and toys and a nice rug to sit on.

stories.title: Peacock’s Castle and the Neighborhood Photo Project
The Wizard's Play-Doh Hat Quest
Hattie and the Wizard's Clover Show

locations.name: Mama Fox's Burrow
locations.curatedDescription: Across the street and up the hill a little ways, a small hole in the ground leads down into the den of Mama Fox. It is a place of bedtime hush — she keeps a stash of little twinkling star stickers there, and visitors come only at night, when the owls and raccoons are awake.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: You might have to, you might have to ask your mom about that question. Oh, and your mom is Mom Fox, and she's in her burrow sleeping.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And so the whole group ran across the street and took a right and then they went up the hill a little ways to a little hole in the ground that led to the underground burrow of Mama Fox.

stories.title: Hattie the Mouse and the Starry Hats

locations.name: Cornell Street
locations.curatedDescription: The big long road that cuts right through the forest, a yellow line down its middle — the vital thread where the woods meet the wider world. Hattie lives on it, Uncle X the Owl shovels his driveway beside his hollow tree on it, a honey tree grows straight out of it, and when moles need a snack from the planet of the Mookers, it doubles as a rocket route to the stars.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Of course, and I live on Cornell Street like you.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: So we only have to fly on Cornell Street and then Kitridge, and then onto Causey, then on Marigold, and then that's the street of the Mookers.

stories.title: Hattie's Indigo Mushroom Adventure
The LED Robot and the Honey Tree of Cornell Street
Hattie Mouse and the Mouse Street Doctors
The Moles' Intergalactic Snack Run

locations.name: The Honey Tree
locations.curatedDescription: A very tall tree on Cornell Street with a whole pot of honey at the top, kept by exactly the right sort of bees making the right sort of honey. Reaching it takes Pooh's tall ladder — clink, clink, clink — and a bit of luck about when the bees are home.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: It's at a beehive and it's the right sort of bees and it's on Cornell Street.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And so Winnie the Pooh and the baby robot went together on Cornell Street and they found a very tall tree, and at the top of the tree they saw...

stories.title: The LED Robot and the Honey Tree of Cornell Street

locations.name: The Lions Stool
locations.curatedDescription: A landmark that appears on every single one of Izzy's maps of the Magic Forest: down the stairs, around the garden, past the tree trunk, past the lions stool — and then you'll be there. No journey through the woods is properly navigated without passing it.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: And then past the, and then past the lions stool and then you'll be there.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: around the hall, down the stairs, around the garden, past the tree trunk, past my night light, through a bedroom and then past the lions stool, down the closet hall

stories.title: The Magic Forest Photo Tour

locations.name: Hattie's Hollow-Tree Workshop
locations.curatedDescription: The Workshop of Hats, nestled in the weathered heart of a hollow tree on Cornell Street. Inside is a cheerful clutter of measuring tapes, scissors, wet pigments and scavenged shells, lit by baskets of glowing red, orange and yellow mushrooms beneath the mysterious indigo witch painting. It smells of cedar, ink, and peanut butter toast, and every hat that matters in the forest was made here.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: I already have a hat so I don't need one of yours, but I would like my mushroom... and I would like an indigo one... but I would like it if it had one mushroom.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: Once upon a time, two clover stickers were on a piece of paper in Hattie the Mouse's workshop. And they happened to be on the piece of paper along with a message.

stories.title: Hattie and the Wizard's Clover Show
Victor's Muddy Mishap
The Magic Forest Photo Tour
Hattie's Indigo Mushroom Adventure

locations.name: The Field
locations.curatedDescription: The sprawling sunny clearing behind Hattie's house, half wildflowers and half legendary mud. Purple, pink, blue and yellow flowers hum with bees drinking nectar — but after rain the low ground turns to deep slick muck that has swallowed whole family cars, until Mistress Mouse's pink tow truck comes bumping to the rescue.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: That's a bee! Buzz buzz buzz! The bee is there!

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: It's Mistress Mouse's truck bumping along the road, and it finally pulled up into the field where the pig family car had gotten stuck in the muck and was buried in mud and leaves and acorns.

stories.title: Mistress Mouse and the Pink Tow Truck Rescue
Hattie's Shell Necklace Adventure
Hattie's Rain Boots and the Honey Bee's Hat

locations.name: The Beehive
locations.curatedDescription: A big brown ball-shaped hive nestled in the middle of a bush covered with bright pink flowers, with one little entrance hole where bees buzz in and out. Ask politely — buzz buzz buzz — and perhaps they will share tiny mugs of shiny golden honey.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And the bee flew down to a bush that was covered with bright pink flowers. And nestled in the middle of the bush was a big brown ball. It was a ball-shaped hive.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: So the bee, can please have your honey? And the bee said buzz buzz buzz. Well, perhaps we can share some honey.

stories.title: Hattie's Rain Boots and the Honey Bee's Hat

locations.name: The Pine Tree
locations.curatedDescription: An aromatic pine in the thickets behind the Mouse Castle, famous twice over: Pinecone Mouse's tiny house sways among its highest needles, and its shady base is where Frasgle took the nap that glued his beautiful long blue fur together with amber sap.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: His fur was very yucky because it was all sticky because Frasgle had taken a nap under a pine tree and all of the pine sap had gone into his beautiful long fluffy blue fur and stuck it all together.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: Once upon a time, Pinecone Mouse woke up in her tiny house high up in a pine tree. And she was very hungry.

stories.title: Frasgle and the Sticky Situation
The Chronicles of Pinecone Mouse and the Pink Tow Truck

locations.name: Hoodie's Nest
locations.curatedDescription: A beautiful nest woven from leaves, twigs and feathers, built by Hoodie the Mouse right after a big lunch of tomato soup, crackers, meatballs and spaghetti. He sleep in it. The end.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: Oh, some leaves and twigs and feathers. And he made his beautiful nest.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: He sleep in it. The end.

stories.title: The Tail of Two Mice: Surprise and Hoodie

locations.name: The Deep Dark Forest
locations.curatedDescription: The deeper, darker part of the woods, where so many trees and leaves crowd overhead that sunlight barely reaches the ground. It is cool and quiet and not scary — just hushed — full of twigs and worms and slugs and bugs, feet going crunch-crunch-crunch. When a friend is lost here at night, rescues run on lanterns and flashlights, following a tiny glow between the trees and then holding hands all the way home.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: It's a little dark there. But I'll be brave.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: They saw twigs and worms and slugs and bugs!

stories.title: The Glowing Expedition for Mole
Hattie's Shell Necklace Adventure
The Wizard's Play-Doh Hat Quest
Tigger's Quest for the Wizard's Magic Wand

locations.name: The Robot Clearing
locations.curatedDescription: A big empty space in the forest with no trees in it — which is lucky, because this is where Hattie keeps her giant robot. Its metal feet are each bigger than a mouse, and when it walks the whole forest shakes with huge crunching steps.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: they cut through the trees and they got to a clearing, which is a big empty space with no trees in it. And there they saw two gigantic metal feet. Each foot was bigger than Mickey or Minnie.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: when its feet stepped on the ground they made a huge crunching sound because the robot was as big as a building, it was as big as a house.

stories.title: Hattie's Giant Robot and the Rainbow Gnome Hat

locations.name: The Rescue Clearing
locations.curatedDescription: A little grassy clearing over a hill and across a stream, where Buddy and Tot found a tiny brown fur ball lying very still in the grass. With blue plastic gloves, a Ziploc bag, and Dr. Izzy's steady help, one small mouse got carried home and made well again.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: It looked like a tiny mouse. It looked like a dead mouse. It looked like a dead mouse but I don't, but I don't know what it is, said Tot.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And they walked along the path, up and over a little hill and across a stream into a little clearing in the forest.

stories.title: Dr. Izzy and the Forest Rescue

locations.name: The Garden
locations.curatedDescription: A well-loved, much-nibbled garden at the forest's edge: a vegetable patch eaten bare by a waddling woodchuck, huge squelchy mud puddles cleaned up one pile at a time (a trick learned from Nana), and the scene of the great pool-noodle-nibbler stakeout, bell and all.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: I saw a big fat woodchuck. And it went waddle-waddle-waddle and it said, "Excuse me, do you have any vegetables? I want to eat them."

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: But you can try it one at a time! I learned that from my nana. I learned that from my nana!

stories.title: The Big Muck Problem: One Pile at a Time
Hattie's Block-Built Nature Walk Adventure
The Mystery of the Pool Noodle Nibbler

locations.name: Mole's Front Yard
locations.curatedDescription: Mole keeps the nicest front yard in the forest: lush green grass thick with dandelions and flowers, perfect for spreading a picnic blanket. His noisy little dark brown car sits nearby, going putt-putt-putt whenever adventure calls.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: Mickey and Minnie and Mole were having a little picnic in Mole's front yard. And Mole had a very nice front yard because he had very lush green grass with lots of dandelions and other flowers.

stories.title: The Putt-Putt Road Trip Adventure

locations.name: Auntie Mulberry's Cottage
locations.curatedDescription: A small cottage deep in the forest with a little round front door, home to a bunny with purple hair and a bright red apron. When something is baking here the smell drifts through the trees and makes mole noses twitch — her magical pie holds raisins, crunchy salty bacon, and slime, and it is somehow delicious.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And then the little round door on the front of the cottage, it popped open. And guess who came out? It was a bunny, but it wasn't just any bunny.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Look, here's raisins!

stories.title: Auntie Mulberry's Magical Mole Pie

locations.name: Oscar Mouse's House
locations.curatedDescription: A tiny house of weathered stone in the middle of the forest on the green planet, with room to land a rocket ship right beside the front door. Oscar Mouse sets his little table with carrots, tea and agua for any traveler who drops in from the sky.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: They saw a tiny house and next to it a tiny mouse right in the middle of the forest.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: A carrot, tea, and agua.

stories.title: Mickey and Minnie's Interstellar Forest Adventure
Orange Frasgle and the Blackberry Seed

locations.name: Seeker's Castle
locations.curatedDescription: At the edge of the forest where the trees thin out stands Seeker's glowing castle — an unassuming front door with a ding-dong doorbell, a tower you can see the whole countryside from, and the famous potion closet: shelf upon dusty shelf of shimmering bottles, one for every world. Fire potions, water potions, prehistoric-land potions... every adventure in the woods starts by choosing one.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: this morning I woke up and I looked in my potion closet, and they were all gone! Someone has stolen all of my potions!

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: I have a fire potion to take me to the fire... to the Fire Island, or a water potion to take me underwater, or a prehistoric land potion.

stories.title: Seeker and the Security Cats: The Potion Caper

locations.name: The Swamp
locations.curatedDescription: A very wet and mucky part of the forest where ferns and moss grow everywhere and the trees rise straight out of the water. Fresh mint grows behind the trees, and on a good day the whole swamp smells of Monch's minty tea steaming over a tiny fire.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: the Mischief Moles were wandering through a different part of the forest than usual. It was a very wet and mucky part of the forest called the swamp.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: You can't stick... you can't put your sticky tongue on the Mischief Moles. You can't do that.

stories.title: Monch the Lizard and the Minty Meditation

locations.name: The Pond
locations.curatedDescription: A beautiful little pond at the edge of the field — the forest's swimming hole. A wooden dock floats on it for cannonballs (splash! splash! sploosh!), its silty shallows hide smooth sun-bleached shells for necklace-making, and its cool water will even soak the stickiest pine sap out of fur.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And they walked through the field and at the edge of the field, there was a beautiful little pond. And they walked to the edge of the pond and there they saw something very interesting.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And it had a little wooden dock floating on it. So they walked out on the dock. And first Mickey jumped in: splash! And then Minnie jumped in: splash! And then Mole jumped in: sploosh!

stories.title: Hattie's Shell Necklace Adventure
Frasgle and the Sticky Situation

locations.name: River Lake
locations.curatedDescription: A nice pond with a name that can't decide what it is, and beside it the Sunlit Rock — a beautiful rock with just the right amount of sunlight to lie on, which is exactly the kind of home a moss needs. Mossy lives there now, bright green and sparkling with tiny droplets, with a second rock placed alongside so friends can stay and talk.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Well, but there's a nice pond nearby called River Lake. Follow me to where River Lake is.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: 'Oh, River Lake! I love it. And now could you find me a beautiful rock with just the right amount of sunlight to lie on? Because that's the kind of new home that I need.'

stories.title: Mossy's New Home at River Lake

locations.name: The Stream
locations.curatedDescription: A little stream of fresh, delicious water, cool enough to drink and splash on your face. Its mirror-still pools are where Eeyore studies his reflection on his birthday, and where a tiny frog named Cindy-Wan the Frog-a-loza lands with a triumphant splash.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: Oh yes, of course. Eeyore was at the stream looking at his reflection, muttering to himself about how "Oh, it's my birthday, but no one has given me any presents at all."

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: Cindy-Wan the Frog-a-loza, a tiny, tiny frog was hopping through the jungle. And they followed Cindy-Wan until he jumped, splash, right into a little stream.

stories.title: Stars and Stories: Piglet's Birthday Surprise
The Great Expedition of the Sas-ma-ras-ma-fla-mas Frog

locations.name: The River
locations.curatedDescription: The mirror-still waterway that traces the forest's wild eastern edge, where the trees grow thick as jungle. Little cars have driven its banks (vroom), raced beside it, and — in Pistis Mouse's case — very nearly into it.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Pistis Mouse tried to go to the river in his little car. Yeah, that’s what that story is about.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And they drove through the hilly part of the jungle, up and down and then down along the side the river in the jungle, vroom

stories.title: Pistis and Potty Mouse's Sprinkle Adventure
Mistress Mouse and the Great Penguin Car Race

locations.name: The Big Rock
locations.curatedDescription: A large stone that serves as the final guidepost on Kitty's map: halfway to the clock tower, halfway to the school, around and across the street, go downwards, around the big rock — and there, opening in the earth just behind it, is the way down to the gopher tunnels.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: And she said halfway to the clock tower, halfway to her school, then around and across the street, go downwards, around a big rock, and then you're there at the gopher tunnel. That's what she said.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: Hmm, let's try it. And so they did all those things and they went around the big rock. And what did they see?

stories.title: The Case of the Carrot-Loving Gophers

locations.name: Papa Mole's New Tunnel
locations.curatedDescription: A freshly dug tunnel home with windows, stairs, lamps and a bookcase — and exactly 1,120 pieces of dirt that had to be swept out with brooms and dustpans before move-in day. The chairs are so comfy that every mole who sits down falls asleep mid-sentence. It is, officially, the best mole hole ever.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: So then, I got out your brooms, now sweep! There's 11, 20 dirt in the rooms.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: This is gonna be the best mole hole ever.

stories.title: The Best Mole Hole Ever
Under the Bed and Over the Sky

locations.name: The Mole Burrow
locations.curatedDescription: The warm heart of the Mischief Mole family, tucked among the cracks of an old mossy stone wall. Everyone snuggles up together under the dirt while Papa Mole reads bedtime chapters from the great big book of Dimitar the Dragon — and when a volcano booms outside, the door and window shut tight and the burrow keeps everybody safe.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: He heard chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, chirp, that's my burrow!

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And Papa Mole said, 'Okay.' And he closed the great big book of Dimitar the Dragon and said, 'We'll continue this another night. Goodnight Disco, goodnight Disco, I love you.'

stories.title: Dimitar the Dragon and the Sleepy Moles
The Legend of the Ice Gem
Oscar Mouse and the Musical Wolf Cub
The Mischief Moles and the Plane of Fire

locations.name: Disco's Glowing Basket House
locations.curatedDescription: Disco's dream sanctuary: a woven basket house glowing from within, its light shining out through the little holes in the weave and scattering stars across every wall and ceiling. There's a roof to lie flat on for stargazing, and owls hooting somewhere off in the dark.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Let's pretend this is a house. Mr. Mole, this is your house. Crawl through through through the tunnel and then you'll find the light inside.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And they looked all around and they saw that there were little holes in the basket and the light was shining through the holes and making stars outside the basket on all the walls and on the ceiling.

stories.title: The Star-Lit Basket Adventure

locations.name: The Underground Library
locations.curatedDescription: Between the roots of an old tree stump hides a very old wooden door with a sign and a doorbell. Down its lamp-lit tunnel lies a big round room ringed floor-to-ceiling with books — big books and little books, fat books and skinny books, real and imaginary. Pick out your books first, then scan them at the checkout counter; Mischief Mouse keeps the collection.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Okay, just pick out your books first and then scan them at the check out counter.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And then, when they went down the tunnel, they got to a big wide-open room, and it was round, and all around the sides were shelves full of books, stacked from floor to ceiling.

stories.title: The Underground Library and the Big Bubble Bonanza

locations.name: Uncle Grisco's Burrow-Laboratory
locations.curatedDescription: Uncle Grisco's sprawling subterranean home: low amber-lit ceilings of packed earth and reinforced timber, the smell of damp clay mixed with a faint whiff of robot ozone. The local moles congregate here for interesting discussions, science, and — when Zigzag the robot gets going — the Cornebyborn dance, shadows flickering on the cavern walls.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Cornebyborn. Come here robot. Actually, come here robot, actually come here robot. We need a name for him. Maybe we can name him Zigzag. Zigzag, actually.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: Uncle Grisco says thank you for the interesting discussion and goes home to his mole house.

stories.title: Zigzag the Dancing Robot and the Cornebyborn Dance
Science and Hand Mountains with Seeker and Uncle Grisco

locations.name: Nana Mole's House
locations.curatedDescription: At the very end of the mole train line, Nana Mole's house opens onto the edge of a big field of wildflowers, with a wonderful shady front porch for sitting. There is iced hibiscus tea with straws, a big bag of magic Legos to dump out, and — on one famous afternoon — a long-legged Lego duck sprinting through the flowers at top speed.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: Well, Nana Mole's house was at the edge of a very big field full of wildflowers and it had a wonderful front porch where they could all sit in the shade and look out at the beautiful sunny day.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Aska-baska-noona-maska.

stories.title: Minnie Mouse and the Long-Legged Lego Duck

locations.name: The Deep Shaft
locations.curatedDescription: Behind Goofy the Gopher's overstuffed armchair and a bookshelf of weathered lore, a meticulously carved shaft plunges straight down — secret stone stairs, handrails and all. The moles who dug it struck something cold and metal at the bottom: the hull of a buried rocket, with one round red button just asking to be pressed.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Go down the tunnel. I see some stairs that we can go on with handrails.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: The mischief moles, Disco and Disco, were digging a new tunnel, deep underneath the garden. Dig, dig, dig through the dirt. And suddenly, their claws came upon something new.

stories.title: The Moles' Intergalactic Snack Run
Seeker's Deep Earth Adventure

locations.name: The Gopher Tunnels
locations.curatedDescription: A sprawling labyrinth of cool earthen passages, really deep underground, home to a hospitable gopher family. Special little bedroom tunnels branch off for each gopher (Nibbler will show you Goober's), a lush raised-bed garden of crunchy carrots grows just outside the entrance, and speed-nibbling contests over tubers and broccoli are taken very seriously.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Who me? Uh, no, I just live in this gopher tunnel and I look like a gopher, but I'm not a gopher. Oh, actually I am a gopher.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And so Izzy and Kitty and the cat crew went into the tunnel and Nibbler led them to a special little tunnel that was Goober's bedroom.

stories.title: Kitty the Cat Superhero and the Gopher Tunnel Visit
The Case of the Carrot-Loving Gophers
Kitty's Crew and the Underground Adventure

locations.name: The Kingdom of the Blind Mice
locations.curatedDescription: Deeper than any other place on the map, where no sunlight has ever reached, little round tunnels wind to a cozy chamber of beds, tables, chairs and shelves of knick-knacks — all arranged by paw, for the blind mice need no light at all. They don't get a lot of visitors these days, and they trade home-grown mushrooms gladly for fresh surface vegetables and cheese.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Oh hello, we don't get a lot of visitors these days. We are the blind mice. We live deep underground in this is our little kingdom, the kingdom of the blind mice.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And the blind mouse led the moles and Seeker through lots of dark little round tunnels all the way to a big chamber that was very cozy and it had little beds and little tables and chairs

stories.title: Seeker's Deep Earth Adventure
